description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the CustomerService class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It contains setup routines and tests for saving a customer, retrieving all customers, and fetching a customer by ID.

classes.name: CustomerServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test suite for the CustomerService class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It tests CRUD operations related to Customer entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creates an instance of CustomerService, sets up test fixture data, and populates test data.

methods.name: testSaveCustomer
methods.description: Tests the saveCustomer function of CustomerDao by mock and verifies the return value.

methods.name: testGetAllCustomer
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of customers based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetCustomerById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single customer by ID.
